title: [smime-tree] Validate content-type signed attribute value per RFC 5652
description: Skoll MEDIUM-24: verify.rs check_message_digest only checks that the content-type signed attribute OID is present, but never decodes and validates the attribute's value equals id-data per RFC 5652 §11.1. After confirming presence, decode the value as ObjectIdentifier and verify it equals ID_DATA.
close_reason: Added validation that the content-type signed attribute value equals id-data per RFC 5652 §11.1. Previously only checked for attribute presence.
